## Not guaranteed

Everything tagged "appearance, approximate" in the part, and every illustration choice. It is shown for looks only and is not checked against a catalogue dimension:

- Corner radii of the compact flange (the figure shows rounded corners without a dimension; drawn as W / 4) (appearance, approximate)
- Pilot length: the figure marks two T dimensions either side of the flange back face; the pilot spigot (O D1 h8) is drawn T long and the flange T thick, which makes the printed L1 equal to the L of the slit table (p.539) plus T in every row. The h8 tolerance of D1 is printed as a class only and is not modelled
- Groove depth (S1 wide, position from L1 - B - S1) is not dimensioned: read from the figure as the cut from the top down to the bottom of the shaft bore; the radial slit is drawn over the ring length B only, from the shaft axis up through the outside on +Y (the stub below the bore is read from the figure) (appearance, approximate)
- Clamp screw side: the screw is drawn on +Y at height X with the clearance hole and counterbore on -X and the tapped hole on +X, read from the figure (appearance, approximate)
- Hole angular position: the 4 mounting holes of the round flange are drawn on the X and Y axes; the figure does not dimension the angle relative to the slit (appearance, approximate)
- Both types are built for every D of the table: the page prints one table for the round and the compact type and no per-type size restriction
- Surface treatment: the page prints 'Stainless steel' in the Surface Treatment column for both types next to a steel material; it is recorded as printed and not modelled
- No chamfers or fillets, and the hex socket head cap screw supplied is not modelled
- Thickness (N): printed, and equal to (D1 - D) / 2 in every row; checked as the sleeve wall, not modelled as a separate feature
- The T-shaped aluminium alloy support C-SHA printed on the same page is not part of this generator (it is in misumi.shf.shaft-holder)
